name: Omaflowy
author: Frank Drewett
description: Today's open todos from Workflowy, in the bar. Click one to complete it, type to capture a new one.

barWidget.description: Open Workflowy todos. Left: panel · Middle: refresh · Right: capture.

schema.label: All tab: cache lifetime (seconds)
schema.description: The All tab reads the whole-account export, which Workflowy limits to one request per minute. Below 60 the limit refuses and the cached list is shown instead.

schema.label: Skip subtrees named
schema.description: Comma-separated. A recurring template can stamp a dozen empty section headers into a day; name its parent here to keep them out.

schema.label: Show items dated today from elsewhere
schema.description: Workflowy's Found Dates: open items carrying today's date that live under another day. They are counted in the bar as well, so the pill never reads 0 while the panel is showing work.

schema.label: Resolve mirrored items
schema.description: Workflowy mirrors are blank on the production API, so anything mirrored into today is invisible. Reading them needs the beta endpoint; turn this off to stay on production and lose mirrors.

schema.label: Hide the pill when today is clear
